title: Two factorizations of the ringed-topos external product comparison
statement:
Let $X,Y,W$ be topoi presented by sites small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaves of commutative rings. Let $q:X\to Y$ and $a,b:W\to X$ be morphisms of ringed topoi with a specified commutation isomorphism $qa\cong qb$. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], canonical derived adjunctions, pullback tensor comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and direct-image composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Write $L=Lq^*$, $R=Rq_*$, $A=La^*$, $B=Lb^*$, $S=Ra_*$ and $U=Rb_*$. Identify $AL\cong BL$ and $RS\cong RU$ by these comparisons. Define $\beta_M:LRM\to UAM$ as the mate of $BL\cong AL$, and $\bar\beta_N:LRN\to SBN$ as the mate of its inverse [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. For a ringed-topos morphism $f$ let $\pi_f: Rf_*E\otimes^L Q\to Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*Q)$ be the adjunct of counit tensor identity, as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence]; tensor symmetry is used to put factors in the displayed order.

For every $M,N\in D(X)$ the two composites
$$\begin{aligned}
RM\otimes^L RN&\xrightarrow{\pi_q}R(LRM\otimes^L N)\xrightarrow{R(\beta_M\otimes1)}R(UAM\otimes^L N)\xrightarrow{R\pi_b}RU(AM\otimes^L BN),\\
RM\otimes^L RN&\xrightarrow{\pi_q}R(M\otimes^L LRN)\xrightarrow{R(1\otimes\bar\beta_N)}R(M\otimes^L SBN)\xrightarrow{R\pi_a}RS(AM\otimes^L BN)
\end{aligned}$$
are equal under $RU\cong RS$. Their common transpose under the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] is
$$ (qa)^*(RM\otimes^L RN)\cong ALRM\otimes^L BLRN\xrightarrow{A(v_M)\otimes B(v_N)}AM\otimes^L BN,$$
where $v:LR\to1$ is the original derived-adjunction counit. No cartesianness, properness, boundedness or invertibility of $\beta,\bar\beta,\pi$ is assumed.
